Big Band Music

🎷 The Ultimate Big Band & Swing Showcase

I. The Sophisticated Welcome (Background & Crooners)

Quiet, elegant, and perfect for cocktail hour.

  1. A Fine Romance – Frank Sinatra

  2. Age Of Loneliness – Enigma

  3. All or Nothing – Diana Krall

  4. America The Beautiful – Ray Charles

  5. As Time Goes By – Peggy Lee

  6. At Last – Etta James

  7. Back In The Saddle Again – Gene Autry

  8. Because You Love Me – Celine Dion

  9. Begin the Beguine – Artie Shaw & His Orchestra

  10. Beyond The Sea – Bobby Darin (Added Artist)

  11. Butterfly Kisses – Bob Carlisle

  12. By Your Side – Sade

  13. Can’t Help Falling In Love – Elvis Presley

II. The Classic Ballroom (Mid-Tempo Swing)

Transitioning from background to “The Floor is Open.” 14. Can’t Take My Eyes Off You – Frankie Valli / Beyond The Sea (Mashup style) 15. Chattanooga Choo Choo – Glenn Miller 16. Cherry Pink and Apple Blossom White – Perez Prado 17. Chicago – Frank Sinatra 18. Could I Have This Dance – Anne Murray 19. Daddy’s Little Girl – Al Martino 20. Don’t Know Why – Norah Jones 21. Dream A Little Dream of Me – Dean Martin 22. Fever – Peggy Lee 23. Fly Me To The Moon – Frank Sinatra 24. Take the “A” Train – Duke Ellington (New Big Band Essential)

III. The Romantic Interlude

Soft ballads and smooth favorites. 25. From This Moment On – Shania Twain 26. Georgia On My Mind – Billie Holiday 27. It Had To Be You – Harry Connick Jr. 28. Have Yourself A Merry Little Christmas – Diana Krall 29. Here and Now – Luther Vandross 30. How Sweet It Is (To Be Loved By You) – James Taylor 31. I Left My Heart In San Francisco – Tony Bennett (Added Artist) 32. San Francisco (Be Sure to Wear Flowers in Your Hair) – Scott McKenzie

IV. The Jitterbug & Jump Session (High Energy)

The DJ’s peak big band dance set. 33. I’m Beginning To See The Light – Billy Eckstine 34. In the Mood – Glenn Miller 35. It Don’t Mean A Thing (If It Ain’t Got That Swing) – Ella Fitzgerald 36. Jump, Jive & Wail – Louis Prima / Brian Setzer Orchestra 37. Sing, Sing, Sing – Benny Goodman (New Big Band Essential) 38. Zoot Suit Riot – Cherry Poppin’ Daddies 39. Woodchopper’s Ball – Woody Herman (New Big Band Essential)

V. Smooth Jazz & Contemporary Pop

  1. Songbird – Kenny G

  2. Killing Me Softly – Roberta Flack

  3. Lady In Red – Chris de Burgh

  4. Let’s Misbehave – Cole Porter / Various

  5. Somewhere Over The Rainbow – Linda Eder

  6. Amazed – Lonestar

  7. What A Wonderful World – Louis Armstrong

  8. L-O-V-E – Nat King Cole & Natalie Cole

VI. The “Strictly Ballroom” Favorites

  1. Love and Marriage – Frank Sinatra

  2. We’ve Only Just Begun – The Carpenters

  3. Only Time – Enya

  4. Night and Day – Dinah Washington

  5. Makin’ Whoopee – Ray Charles

  6. Mack The Knife – Bobby Darin

  7. Mona Lisa – Nat King Cole

  8. Moonlight Serenade – Glenn Miller

  9. Moon River – Andy Williams

  10. My Heart Belongs To Daddy – Marilyn Monroe

VII. The Grand Finale & Singalongs

  1. My Heart Will Go On – Celine Dion

  2. My Way – Frank Sinatra

  3. Unforgettable – Natalie Cole & Nat King Cole

  4. Crazy – Patsy Cline

  5. Puttin’ On The Ritz – Fred Astaire

  6. Raindrops Keep Fallin’ On My Head – B.J. Thomas

  7. Que Sera, Sera (Whatever Will Be, Will Be) – Doris Day (Added Artist)

  8. Satin Doll – Duke Ellington

  9. Sea Of Love – The Honeydrippers

  10. Dreaming of You – Selena

  11. Signed, Sealed, Delivered (I’m Yours) – Stevie Wonder

  12. Summer Wind – Frank Sinatra

  13. Pennsylvania 6-5000 – Glenn Miller

  14. Sentimental Journey – Les Brown & Doris Day

  15. Sway – Dean Martin

  16. Sweet Caroline – Neil Diamond

  17. Tea for Two Cha Cha – Tommy Dorsey & His Orchestra

  18. That’s Amore – Dean Martin

  19. That Old Black Magic – Louis Prima & Keely Smith

  20. The Very Thought Of You – Nat King Cole

  21. Till There Was You – The Beatles

  22. The Girl From Ipanema – Astrud Gilberto & Stan Getz

  23. The Way You Look Tonight – Frank Sinatra

  24. Unchained Melody – The Righteous Brothers

  25. Volare – Dean Martin

  26. What is This Thing Called Love – Sarah Vaughan

  27. When I Fall in Love – Nat King Cole

  28. White Christmas – Bing Crosby

  29. Wind Beneath My Wings – Bette Midler

  30. You Are So Beautiful – Joe Cocker

  31. When You Say Nothing At All – Alison Krauss

  32. You’d Be So Nice To Come Home To – Julie London

  33. You’re Nobody Till Somebody Loves You – Dean Martin

  34. New York, New York – Frank Sinatra (New Big Band Essential)
